source_validation_policy: Every successful receipt's recorded repository source hash must match current bytes; mismatches are rejected, not silently grandfathered.
selection_policy: Prefer valid confirmations over screens, longer measurements over shorter, then most recent receipt; never maximize throughput. Retain all receipts.
contrast_policy: Identical sequence, micro/update token budgets, warmup/measurement count, training controls, recompute flag, input hash, hardware/versions and common source hashes. Unpaired confirmations make no relative-speed claim.
confirmed_tuned_contrast_policy: Practical same-size/update-budget recipe comparison, not isolated attention. Require identical sequence, input/target tokens per update, at least 40 and equal measured steps, five warmups, input hash, all training controls except micro_batch/grad_accum, hardware/software and common source hashes. Explicitly allow microbatch, accumulation and KDA recompute policy to differ. Retain alternative configurations; never select maximum rate or latest across configurations.

cuda_parity.interpretation: Passes are within the fixed BF16 numerical tolerances; no bitwise or language-quality equivalence claim

recorded_observation.provider: Windows Get-Counter: GPU Process Memory / Shared Usage
recorded_observation.scope: One live snapshot during this case only; not a peak or full time series. It supports shared-memory use in this case, not retrospective residency claims about other runs. The read-only counter query ran concurrently with this screening measurement.

shared_memory_observation.interpretation: One live process shared-usage snapshot during the named case only; not peak memory, a time series, or evidence about other runs.

limitations: Synthetic repeated input; falling loss is not evidence of language quality.
Benchmark-only KDA hybrid, not a Kimi MLA reproduction or complete Kimi model.
No UI integration, deployment, checkpoint export or resume contract was added.
FP32 model/gradient/GPU-Adam state with BF16 autocast; this is separate from earlier BF16-shadow/NVFP4 optimizer studies.
Parameter counts are close but not identical; same seed does not imply identical architectures or initial weight tensors.
CUDA peaks were reset after warmup; they describe measured-step allocator usage, excluding initialization peaks. They do not measure physical GPU residency.
External FLA/Triton versions are recorded; repository source hashes do not hash every installed provider file.
